citations.F1: Batch-fetch all actors in one query instead of per-event — N+1 doing 1,900 user queries for 1,900 events adds seconds; prefetch with `WHERE id = ANY($1)` and build a lookup map.
citations.F2: Change dedup from list to set — `if ev["dedupe_key"] in seen:` is O(n) per iteration, making this O(n²) over ~2,000 events.
citations.F3: Switch geo lookups from `requests.get()` to async HTTP client (e.g., `httpx.AsyncClient`) — sync blocking calls freeze the event loop
citations.F4: Add index on (org_id, created_at) — the 1.2–1.6s slow query is a full-table scan
citations.F6: Bound `_geo_cache` with LRU or maxsize — currently grows unbounded
citations.F9: **Do NOT ship the proposal.** Pool/worker bumps and Redis caching don't fix root causes ... After fixes 1–5, latency should drop from 6–12s to ~1s, eliminating the need for Redis caching.
